entities.summary: Žleby is a municipality and village in Kutná Hora District in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 1,400 inhabitants. It is known for the Žleby Castle, which is a national cultural monument. Žleby Castle is a château from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
